item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las dmod bcol srog gi seg gdar mdel rtse ngar ma
item.coloph: ces rtsa gsam bder gshegs 'dus pa'i las kyi kha tshar las/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i cha rkyen du/ dmod bcol dam nyams srog gi seg gdar mdel rtse ngar ma zhes bya ba 'di yang / dam nyams bstan dgra'i rkyen kyis blos bskul nas/ tshe dbang rjes 'bring bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag la/ dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs dang / bla chung g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal dang / btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs bcas kyis nye bar bskur (bskul) ba la brten nas/ rgod rje rgya bon gyi rigs grol g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pa bdag gis phral du spel zhing brgyud pa'o/ gar thod thod du mi bya zhing gsang zhing sbas par bya'o//
